faqs.question: What does the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Endometrium test measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB Complex) or Non-Tuberculosis Bacteria (NTM/ MOTT) in the endometrium sample.

faqs.question: Why is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Endometrium test done?
faqs.answer: • To diagnose infection by Mycobacterium tuberculosis or Non-Tuberculosis Bacteria • To identify the specific bacteria causing the infection • To determine appropriate treatment options and prevent disease progression • To monitor the effectiveness of ongoing treatment

faqs.question: When is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Endometrium test recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: Your doctor may recommend this test if you have: • Symptoms of an infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis or Non-Tuberculosis Bacteria • High-risk factors for tuberculosis or other bacterial infections • A history of exposure to tuberculosis or other bacterial infections

faqs.question: What if the results of the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Endometrium test are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate an infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis or Non-Tuberculosis Bacteria.

faqs.question: What to expect during the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Endometrium test?
faqs.answer: • Your doctor will collect a sample of the endometrium from your uterus. • The sample will be sent to the laboratory for analysis.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Endometrium test?
faqs.answer: • No dietary restrictions are necessary before this test. • Inform your doctor about any medications you are taking, as they may interfere with test results. Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Endometrium test?
faqs.answer: • Endometrial biopsy: A tissue sample is obtained from the endometrium for further analysis. • PCR testing: Polymerase Chain Reaction technique may be used to detect the presence of specific bacteria or DNA in the sample.

faqs.question: What is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Endometrium test also known as?
faqs.answer: Endometrial AFB Culture, Endometrial Tuberculosis Testing

faqs.question: What is endometrial tuberculosis?
faqs.answer: Endometrial tuberculosis is a condition caused by a Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection in the endometrium. It can lead to symptoms such as pelvic pain, abnormal vaginal bleeding, and infertility. Early diagnosis and treatment are essential for optimal management.
